1_1: Climate change is NOT causing melting ice (e.g., glaciers or sea ice), thawing permafrost, or reduced snow cover.
1_2: We are heading into a period of global cooling or an ice age.
1_3: We are experiencing cold weather, therefore climate change is not happening.
1_4: There has been a hiatus or pause in global warming. The climate has not warmed or changed very much over the past few decades.
1_5: Oceans are not warming and may even be cooling.
1_6: Sea level rise is exaggerated and not accelerating.
1_7: Climate change does not cause or worsen extreme weather events such as heatwaves, droughts, wildfires and floods.
1_8: Climate advocates and alarmist changed the name from global warming to climate change so that cold weather as well as hot can be taken as evidence.
1_9: Oceans are not becoming more acidic and ocean pH is not falling.
2_1: Humans are not the causing change. Instead, climate change is due to natural variation.
2_2: Non-greenhouse gas human climate forcings such as from aerosols, changes land use, or black soot on snow are causing climate change.
2_3: There's no evidence for greenhouse effect or carbon dioxide driving climate change.
3_1: Climate sensitivity is low and there are negative feedbacks that will reduce warming.
3_2: Plants and animals are not showing harmful impacts from climate change and may be benefiting from climate change.
3_4: Human-caused climate change will only lead to a few degrees (or less) of warming and so no cause for alarm.
3_5: Climate change does not lead to conflict and is not a national security threat.
3_6: Climate change does not have negative impacts on human health.
4_1: Climate solutions are harmful to the economy, society, and/or the environment.
4_2: Climate solutions are ineffective and won't work.
4_3: It's too hard to solve climate change and so we shouldn't try.
4_4: We have already made a lot of progress on climate change and don't need to do anything else.
5_1: There is no scientific consensus on climate change. Scientists continue to disagree on many aspects of climate change and the science is not settled.
5_2: Proxy climate data from things such as ice cores, tree rings boreholes, etc., are unreliable.
5_3: Temperature data is unreliable and/or biased.
5_4: Climate models are flawed, unreliable, or uncertain.
6_1: Climate change proponents are alarmist, biased, wrong, hypocritical, and/or politically motivated.
6_2: Climate change is a hoax or conspiracy. We have been deceived by climate scientists, politicians, bureaucrats, and environmental organizations on climate change.
7_1: Fossil fuels are plentiful and should be used.
7_2: Fossil fuels are good for the economy, society, and/or the environment.
7_3: Fossil fuels are necessary to meet energy demand.
7_4: We have a right to profit from fossil fuels just like others have.
